g.aria-label: Practical Conditioning: Singularity at Pure Noise (α₁ = 0)
Divides by α_t to reconstruct x̂₀!
Blows up if schedule reaches α₁ = 0
Linear: x̂₀ = x_t − t û (no division!)
Cosine v: x̂₀ = α_t x_t − σ_t v̂
Well-conditioned at both t=0 and t=1
On the linear path, ‖û − u‖² = ‖ε̂ − ε‖²/(1−t)² = ‖x̂₀ − x₀‖²/t² balances both ends
